limits.verification_scope: C-shim partial correctness under the explicit public memory contract; completion is determined by proof/status.json
limits.initial_output_values: all uint32 values represented by the owned UIntArray
limits.observation: u32(Init[column] + sum over all rows of RDMap[base + row * stride + column])
limits.rows_domain: 1..2^64-1, subject to rd_inputs and owned readable memory
limits.channels_domain: 1..2^62-1, subject to readable input and writable output capacity
limits.stride_domain: 0..2^64-1, subject to the explicit nonwrapping row-footprint condition
limits.address_formula: unwrapped mathematical integer base + row * stride + column
limits.memory_domain: Every rd_inputs address belongs to the single owned rd_mem; row read footprints cannot cross the 64-bit address boundary. Numeric pointer wrapping and cyclic address layouts are outside this contract.
limits.read_aliases: stride zero, overlapping rows, and zero/input aliases are allowed through one RDMap
limits.outputs: Owned UIntArray resources are separate from rd_mem; public equivalent has two separate outputs with the same Init
limits.zero_condition: rows mod 7 = 0, or rd_zeros in the same map:40 bytes for channels>=32, otherwise max(8,channels) bytes
limits.params: unused; no read of params memory

rvv.inactive_lanes: as specified by the scalar-field C-shim helper contracts

limits.repair_provenance: proof/repair.json and exact per-side patches; original counterexamples are retained separately
limits.native_evidence: finite independent helper and column-sum oracles, current actual scalar-field C, public equivalent, canaries, and both-wrong rejection; not additional formal proof credit
